case: If you only want Pierce as a stash for a deep playoff run, this still doesn't come close to paying off, so pass. Gibbs is the RB1 this season and is worth far more than Pierce, who sits on IR with no return week on file. Your RBs in the top 36 would drop from 4 to 3, and you're in a playoff spot where you need points now, not a long-shot hope. The only upside is that Pierce has tended to finish seasons a little stronger, but his coach reportedly can't put a timetable on his heel. Keep Gibbs and let Return of T Mac find another way to make its push.
